pkgmetadata.longdescription: Rustinion agent: enrols the machine, reports inventory and health and applies approved updates. Portage owns /usr/bin/rustinion: the agent never replaces its own binary on a Portage install (it only reports that a newer version exists); update it with emerge. The enrolment in /etc/rustinion is kept across upgrades and removal.

use.flag: Install the remote-access helper (screen/audio capture and input for remote-desktop sessions) and its runtime libraries (openh264, opus, libpulse, libva)
Also install the PipeWire build of the helper (GNOME/KDE portal and Mutter capture on Wayland; amd64 only)
